title: Terrain Lander 2

versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: TERRAIN LANDER FRAGMENT 1
versions.note: damaged terrain/lander recording. Exact 208-byte readable prefix matches three variants; remainder damaged
versions.unavailableReason: Incomplete, uncertain, or nonstandard captured payload; see the recovery validation. The source refers to extensions, external cassette data, machine code, or functions unavailable in the stock player.
versions.startupSource:
5 DIM M(127)
10 PI=3.14159
20 A=PI/2
30 CLS
40 OY=47-RND(20)
50 FORX=0TO127
60 Y=47-RND(20)
70 IF RND(3)=1THEN Y=OY:GOTO 90   
80 IF ABS(Y-OY)>4THEN60   
90 LINE(X,47)-(X,Y),SET
95 M(X)=Y
100 OY=Y
